findings.title: Unknown replacement-create outcome is stranded when payoff retires the predecessor
findings.status: confirmed in exact84 source; retained historical failing probe documented, not rerun

original_reproduction.note: Retrieved original comment4/8 refers to intermediate ac883d... source. Final ebe20e9/e3b05e... receipt carries the finding forward. Exact84 path is independently traced here; no original probe executable/report was supplied by the comment.

correction_invariants: Commit a durable replacement attempt and original signed remaining contract before provider creation; predecessor terminal state cannot imply that an unresolved successor is terminal.
Keep unresolved successor creation visible and block duplicate creation even after permanent financing payoff.
Let authenticated owner recovery bind the recovered candidate to the originally reserved exact contract after payoff; do not require new unpaid periods or active/grace finance state.
Verify identity and contract before cancellation, require terminal readback, keep failed/unknown retirement pending for owner/scheduler.
Never reverse committed receipts, change license/domain/rights history, or reopen paid_off_at to recover billing.
Keep audit, predecessor history and retained candidate identity atomic; delayed events and audit failures must not erase recovery obligations.

findings.title: Manual receipts after completed enrollment leave a full-amount ARB collecting against reduced installments
findings.status: confirmed in exact84 source; retained historical failing probe documented, not rerun

original_reproduction.note: Retrieved original comment6/30 directly identifies e3b05e... source.3 returned pending_first_payment cases and3 synthetic active projections; exact raw probe/report is not supplied. Adjacent native suites do not cover this timing.

correction_invariants: Durably detect that a committed external/manual receipt changed any installment still covered by a retained full-amount ARB.

Preserve the authoritative receipt and put the obsolete automatic contract into a sticky recovery/retirement state under the existing financial serialization; gateway failure cannot roll back the receipt.
Retire only the exact retained contract and require verified terminal readback before permitting a replacement or another collection path.
Replacement eligibility must inspect every remaining installment and respect partial, nonconsecutive and fully-paid receipts; never silently reschedule their original full balances.
Preserve permanent payoff, license identity, domain records, signed terms and prior gateway history.

Keep scheduler/owner retries idempotent and duplicate-create fenced; separately handle a verified provider receipt arriving after manual payment as an accounting/reconciliation fact, not a second full local settlement.

bounded_observation.summary: New software/finance gateway rows omit original environment/account/revision, and adapters reread current credentials for each request. Software cancellation sends cancel before verifying returned contract. Sandbox credentials can change through payments_save.
bounded_observation.current_guards: Current UI permits only disabled/sandbox. Code-level and reviewed-production gates remain.
not_claimed: No cross-merchant gateway-ID collision or actual wrong-customer cancellation.
No provider semantics or real sandbox behavior established.
bounded_observation.next_review: Bind stored gateway state to original provider environment/account before I/O and verify one immutable transport context across each operation; test credential changes with synthetic providers before live activation.
